Main/MainView/subtitle: Pack your bag and set out again
item.sword.name: Frostline Longsword
item.sword.desc: Frost-like patterns ripple along the blade, as if it holds the northern wind.
item.axe.name: Redrock Battleaxe
item.axe.desc: A heavy axe forged from redrock ore; its edge still holds the warmth of a mountain fire.
item.bow.name: Whisperwood Bow
item.bow.desc: A light woodland bow whose string still seems wet with morning dew.
item.staff.name: Starlight Staff
item.staff.desc: A wisp of starlight sleeps in its sapphire; in silence you can hear it hum.
item.shield.name: Lion Shield
item.shield.desc: A steel shield with a lion crest; the worn rim tells of a guardian's oath.
item.helmet.name: Warden Helm
item.helmet.desc: Left by an ancient warden; an unyielding will hides behind the silver visor.
item.armor.name: Dawn Breastplate
item.armor.desc: It glows gold in the morning light and bears a crusader's blessing.
item.boots.name: Gale Boots
item.boots.desc: Soft leather boots made for long treks across hills and wilds.
item.ring.name: Ruby Ring
item.ring.desc: A warm ruby set in a fine gold band, like a sleeping ember.
item.amulet.name: Jade Amulet
item.amulet.desc: A blue-green stone with a rippling sheen, said to protect travelers.
item.redPotion.name: Healing Potion
item.redPotion.desc: A sweet-smelling red tonic every traveler carries.
item.bluePotion.name: Mana Potion
item.bluePotion.desc: A clear blue draught flecked with starlight, never far from a mage.
item.staminaPotion.name: Stamina Potion
item.staminaPotion.desc: Green and fizzing, it smells like a citrus grove after rain.
item.antidote.name: Antidote
item.antidote.desc: A deep purple remedy tied with the apothecary's cord.
item.elixir.name: Stardew Elixir
item.elixir.desc: Golden dew so bright a single drop lights up the whole vial.
item.herb.name: Dewleaf
item.herb.desc: A fresh herb wet with dew, hiding a small white flower.
item.mushroom.name: Glowcap
item.mushroom.desc: A red cap with pale spots, found in damp, quiet woods.
item.ore.name: Iron Ore
item.ore.desc: A heavy grey ore every blacksmith is glad to see.
item.crystal.name: Frost Crystal
item.crystal.desc: An ice-blue cluster that leaves a chill in your palm.
item.leather.name: Supple Leather
item.leather.desc: A neat roll of leather for mending gear and packs.
item.key.name: Old City Key
item.key.desc: A brass key to a forgotten door deep in the old city.
item.scroll.name: Lost Map
item.scroll.desc: A sealed parchment marking the way to lost ruins.
item.coinPouch.name: Supply Pouch
item.coinPouch.desc: A leather pouch with a compass crest and a glint of gold.
item.gem.name: Dusk Gem
item.gem.desc: Dusky violet light flows through its facets; merchants love it.
